name: Barry
description: A hit man from the Midwest moves to Los Angeles and gets caught up in the city's theatre arts scene.

videos.title: Chapter One: Make Your Mark
videos.overview: A Midwestern contract killer gets hit with the acting bug while on a job in LA.

videos.title: Chapter Two: Use It
videos.overview: Gene encourages his class to channel grief into artistic expression. Barry faces a dilemma.

videos.title: Chapter Three: Make the Unsafe Choice
videos.overview: Barry fulfills an obligation, and comforts Sally after an audition gone awry. The Chechens welcome a hitman legend.

videos.title: Chapter Four: Commit ... to YOU
videos.overview: Barry finds that extricating himself from Fuches, and winning Sally's affections, is more difficult than he thought.

videos.title: Chapter Five: Do Your Job
videos.overview: Barry looks to hit the reset button with Sally, and finds himself paired with a reckless acquaintance named Taylor.

videos.title: Chapter Six: Listen with Your Ears, React with Your Face
videos.overview: Barry tries to distance himself from Taylor, while Moss looks to end her association with Gene.

videos.title: Chapter Seven: Loud, Fast, and Keep Going
videos.overview: A deadly shootout threatens Barry's timely participation in Sally's big stage moment.

videos.title: Chapter Eight: Know Your Truth
videos.overview: Barry vows to give up his life of crime. Moss closes in on an arrest.

videos.title: The Show Must Go On, Probably?
videos.overview: Barry tries to convince Sally and the rest of the class to go ahead with a performance, despite the absence of teacher Gene Cousineau, who's grief-stricken after the disappearance of Detective Moss. With Goran gone, NoHo Hank and Cristobal's new partnership faces growing pains and jealousy issues. Back in Cleveland, Fuches learns that replacement hitmen don't come easy.

videos.title: The Power of No
videos.overview: Facing pressure from Noho Hank, Barry struggles to pull off an important hit. After asking the class to mine their personal traumas for an original piece, Gene decides to confront his own past. A visit to her agents leaves Sally disappointed. Fuches tries to evade questions in Cleveland.

videos.title: Past = Present x Future Over Yesterday
videos.overview: As part of a class project, Gene tasks Barry with revisiting his past, and Sally reflects on her own personal history. Barry offers to provide training to NoHo Hank's men. Fuches finds Barry in an unexpected location.

videos.title: What?!
videos.overview: Barry's patience is put to the test when a figure from Sally's past arrives in LA. Gene gets a pleasant surprise and encourages Barry to believe that change is possible.

videos.title: ronny/lily
videos.overview: An encounter that Barry never could have predicted has surprising effects.

videos.title: The Truth Has a Ring to It
videos.overview: In preparation for his big scene with Sally, Barry works with Gene to help get into character. Sally resolves to embrace her truth. Noho Hank prepares for a big night with his newly-trained men. Fuches goes on a mission.

videos.title: The Audition
videos.overview: Barry prepares for his first audition under Gene's guidance. Sally takes a stand in a meeting with a major TV producer. Noho Hank bares all.

videos.title: berkman > block
videos.overview: Barry is out for vengeance. Noho Hank faces the looming threat of being sent home. Sally makes a split-second decision on the night of the acting class' big performance. Fuches turns to an unexpected source for help.
